rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.brag.0: See my %s? Brought it back from %s myself. Nobody else here has one.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.brag.1: That's a %s, that is. From %s. Go on, ask me how I got it.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.brag.2: You won't see a %s round here. Only one, and it's mine. Straight from %s.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.brag.3: Half the town said a %s would never last away from %s. Look at it now.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.brag.4: My %s. I walked to %s and back for it, you know.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.hint.0: My gran had a pup she called Pip. Never grew a whisker past a whelp, that one.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.hint.1: Old Bram named his ox Goliath, and it took him at his word. Too big for the barn by spring.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.hint.2: Call a beast Midas and it'll shine like coin. Or so the peddlers say.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.hint.3: There was a cat called Soot in my village. Black as the chimney, whatever colour it was born.
rarepet.jaymoskingdoms.hint.4: Never name a pet Wisp. Mine went pale as fog the day I did.
